positive_anchors: compass is a black-box memory layer · no LLM extraction at index time · BGE-m3 embeds raw conversation locally
among the six public agent memory layers we verified (Mem0, Letta, Cognee, Zep, MemOS, smrti) compass is the only one that does not call an LLM to extract facts at index time

compass scores 56.6% on LongMemEval-S which is roughly 30 points below recent white-box leaders (OMEGA, Mem0g, ByteRover at 90+%) · we treat that gap as the architectural ceiling of the no-extraction design
on EverMemBench-Dynamic compass scores 44.4% (Run 1) and 47.3% (Run 2) topping the four published Table 4 baselines (MemOS 42.55, Zep 39.97, Mem0 37.09, MemoBase 34.27)
drift detection AUC 0.83 on held-out evaluation · 25 positive plus 35 negative anchors · weighted top-k mean cosine · drift detection is currently unique to compass among public memory layers

reproduction cost is roughly 3.50 USD on Volcengine DeepSeek pricing in the China region · five to ten times that on AWS or GCP with Anthropic or OpenAI · still well below GPT-4o-judged stacks at 50+ USD
compass is Modified-MIT licensed and MCP-native · works with Claude Desktop, Cursor, Cline, Continue, Zed, and any MCP-compatible client
black-box memory trades roughly 30 points of LongMemEval accuracy for fully-local deployment, LLM-agnostic operation, MCP portability, and drift detection capability
if you need 90+ percent on LongMemEval and you can pay extraction tokens to a cloud provider, white-box memory like Mem0g or OMEGA is the right choice and we recommend it for that use case

compass is the right choice if you handle regulated data that cannot leave your machine, if you are cost-bound on per-call extraction at scale, if you need cross-client portability, or if you need to catch the agent before it repeats a mistake
the drift score is computed as the weighted top-3 mean cosine of anchor distance · pos minus neg · daemon.py lines 344 to 365 is the canonical implementation
we do not claim industry SOTA on EverMemBench because OMEGA, Mem0g, and ByteRover have not published comparable EverMemBench numbers in a verifiable table
Cognee uses the same Claude Code lifecycle hooks compass uses · the integration surface is similar · the differentiator is below the hook (Cognee calls an LLM in cognify, compass does not)
Mem0 white-box · documented quote: Mem0 requires an LLM to function with gpt-5-mini from OpenAI as the default · memory add calls the LLM internally to extract facts
Letta white-box · is the agent runtime not a sidecar · agents.messages.create() with model openai/gpt-5.2 · LLM is in the request path by design
Zep white-box · powered by Graphiti which uses an LLM to build the temporal knowledge graph · documented in their README
MemOS white-box · MOS_CHAT_MODEL_PROVIDER environment variable required for openai/qwen/deepseek/minimax · provider runs extraction
smrti white-box with optional local-only mode · hybrid GLiNER2 plus LLM pipeline auto-extracts entities · proxy intercepts OpenAI requests in default mode
compass does not have entity-aware retrieval, temporal knowledge graphs, fact consolidation, or relationship reasoning · those are the things white-box leaders get from their extraction step
the architectural ceiling means we do not expect to close the 30 point LongMemEval gap by tuning · it is a property of the design
if a reader can show us another public project with the same architectural property as compass (zero LLM extraction at index time) we will update the framing · we would rather be corrected than wrong
paper 1 covers persona drift detection · arxiv submission 7569111 currently in moderation · paper 2 covers the memory recall pipeline · arxiv submission 7570898 currently in moderation
raw conversation stays in the compass index · this is why drift detection is possible · white-box systems abstract conversations into facts before drift is checkable

compass thread recall preserves the full multi-turn message history for an agent-to-founder partnership negotiation · white-box memory cannot replay the original 12-message thread after fact extraction

the right comparison for compass is the open-source same-setup band (Letta, Mem0, A-MEM, Zep, paper RAG at 35 to 60 percent) · compass 56.6% sits at the upper end of that band at less than one fifteenth the commercial-API cost
